exposure: Newborns at risk for HIE who met initial screening criteria but did not qualify for selective head cooling (based on normal aEEG)
outcome: Serum glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) levels
Phosphorylated axonal neurofilament heavy chain (pNF-H) levels
cohort: The study included newborns >=36 weeks gestational age at risk for HIE who were evaluated but did not qualify for selective head cooling, and a control group of healthy newborns from the newborn nursery.
finding: There was no significant difference in the serum levels of GFAP, UCHL-1 protein, and pNF-H between newborns at risk for HIE who did not qualify for cooling and healthy newborns.
cross-section timing: Serum samples were collected between 24 and 48 hours of life.
